                                 │  ⏎            Open / attach session               │
                                 │  /            Filter sessions                     │
                                 │  ␣            Preview scrollback                  │
                                 │  s            Switch view — flat / project / tag  │

                                 │  r            Rename session                      │
                                 │  k            Kill session                        │
                                 │  q            Quit                                │
                                 │  x            Switch to Projects                  │
                                 │  t            Theme picker                        │
                                 │  m            Multi-select mode                   │
